name: Brave-Origin
description: Run Brave Origin in your web browser over HTTPS. Choose Wayland stable (default), Wayland beta, X11 stable, or X11 beta when installing through Apps. Saves bookmarks, settings, and downloads. Includes password protection, copy and paste, audio, and automatic browser updates.

paths.name: Config & Profile Storage
paths.description: Persistent directory for browser profile, downloads, and state.

ports.name: Web HTTPS Port
ports.description: Single-origin HTTPS web port for remote browser access.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Initial login password. Required when password protection is enabled; use reset-password.sh to change it after setup.

variables.name: Automatic Display Resize
variables.description: Resize the desktop to fit your browser window automatically. Disable only to use a fixed width and height.

variables.name: Keep Browser Maximized
variables.description: Prevent minimizing, restoring, or dragging a maximized browser window. Disable to restore the previous window controls.

variables.name: Display Width
variables.description: Fixed desktop width in pixels; used only when Automatic Display Resize is disabled.

variables.name: Display Height
variables.description: Fixed desktop height in pixels; used only when Automatic Display Resize is disabled.

variables.name: Enable Audio
variables.description: Enable PulseAudio virtual sink and unified Opus audio streaming.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Download browser updates in the background and install them while the browser is stopped.

variables.name: Require Password
variables.description: Require a password to open the browser. Set a password below before starting.

variables.name: GPU Device
variables.description: Render device to use when /dev/dri is passed through.
